subject: reasoning
question: Town W is to the south of Town X. Town Y is to the east of Town W. Town Z is to the north of Town Y. Town A is to the west of Town Z. Town X is to the north-east of Town A. What is the position of Town W with respect to Town A?
solution:
**Given: **Town W is to the south of Town X. Town Y is to the east of Town W. Town Z is to the north of Town Y. Town A is to the west of Town Z. Town X is to the north-east of Town A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63c45efe926db5ce6b784de4456ad4458a8347f4de837df8084368e28f7a307c.png] 

Thus, Town W is to the Southeast of Town A.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
